card.vocal_coaching.name: Vocal Coaching
card.vocal_coaching.headline.1: Another early session. The high notes are coming back.
card.vocal_coaching.headline.2: Scales again. Nobody photographs this part.
card.vocal_coaching.headline.3: Your coach doesn't praise you. That's how you know it's working.
card.vocal_coaching.headline.4: Breathe from lower down. Again. Lower.
card.open_mic.name: Open Mic
card.open_mic.flavor: Three songs and a room that isn't listening. Yet.
card.open_mic.headline.1: An open-mic crowd goes quiet mid-song. That almost never happens.
card.open_mic.headline.2: The open-mic regulars are already telling people they saw it first.
card.viral_stunt.name: Viral Stunt
card.viral_stunt.flavor: Thirty seconds. Make them count. Make them share it.
card.press_junket.name: Press Junket
card.press_junket.text: Craft 20+: gain 7 Hype, 1 Heat. Otherwise: gain 4 Hype, 4 Heat.
card.press_junket.flavor: Twenty interviews. The same four questions.
card.press_junket.headline.1: ON THE RECORD: THE {SUBJECT} TALKS FAME AND FAMILY
card.press_junket.headline.3: THE {SUBJECT} OPENS UP: "I'M JUST LIKE YOU, REALLY"
card.side_gig.name: Side Gig
card.side_gig.flavor: Weddings pay on the night. In cash.
card.side_gig.headline.1: A wedding band, Saturday. It covers the rent.
card.side_gig.headline.2: Backing vocals on someone else's song. Cash, no credit.
card.side_gig.headline.3: Three hours of covers in a hotel bar. Nobody's listening. It pays.
card.side_gig.headline.4: Singing lessons for a twelve-year-old who'd rather be anywhere else.
card.side_gig.headline.5: A corporate party, a borrowed suit, a setlist someone else chose.
card.lay_low.name: Lay Low
card.lay_low.flavor: Stay in. Order food. Let it pass.
card.lay_low.headline.1: A quiet week, on purpose. The phone buzzes; you let it.
card.lay_low.headline.2: You stay in. Let someone else be the story.
card.networking.name: Networking
card.networking.headline.1: A party you weren't quite invited to. You leave with six new numbers.
card.networking.headline.2: Drinks with people who know people.
card.networking.headline.3: You laugh at a joke you didn't hear. It seems to help.
card.crisis_pr.name: Crisis PR
card.crisis_pr.text: Needs a Scandal and £4,000. Pay £4,000: remove a Scandal for good.
card.crisis_pr.flavor: Somebody's job is to make this go away.
card.crisis_pr.headline.1: A publicist makes some calls. By morning, a different story is trending.
card.crisis_pr.headline.2: A publicist's invoice arrives. So does a quieter week.
card.studio_session.name: Studio Session
card.studio_session.flavor: The red light means nobody breathes.
card.studio_session.headline.1: Eleven takes of the same line. The eleventh was the one.
card.studio_session.headline.2: A long night in the studio, with nothing to show for it yet.
card.tabloid_story.name: The Breakup Story
card.tabloid_story.inhand.1: Every interview now starts with the same question.
card.tabloid_story.inhand.2: You've stopped answering the phone to numbers you don't know.
card.tabloid_story.headline.1: EXCLUSIVE: THE SPLIT THEY TRIED TO KEEP QUIET
card.public_feud.name: The Feud
card.public_feud.inhand.2: Someone always wants you to take a side.
card.public_feud.headline.1: WAR OF WORDS: {SUBJECT} FIRES BACK AT RIVAL
card.public_feud.headline.2: THE FEUD: WHO SAID WHAT, AND WHY IT MATTERS
card.ghostwriter.name: Ghostwriter
card.ghostwriter.flavor: Your song, their name. Your rent, paid.
card.ghostwriter.headline.1: Someone else writes the bridge. Your name goes on it.
card.ghostwriter.headline.2: The best line on the record isn't yours. It was expensive.
card.meditation_retreat.name: Meditation Retreat
card.meditation_retreat.text: Needs 10 Craft. Lose 4 Craft: lose 8 Heat.
card.meditation_retreat.flavor: No phones. No mirrors. Just birds.
card.meditation_retreat.headline.1: You switch your phone off for a weekend. The world keeps turning.
card.meditation_retreat.headline.2: Three days of silence. The loudest thing is your own breathing.
card.apology_tour.name: Apology Tour
card.apology_tour.text: Needs a Scandal. Lose 6 Hype: remove a Scandal for good.
card.apology_tour.flavor: Say sorry like you mean it. Then again, tomorrow.
card.apology_tour.headline.1: THE APOLOGY: THE {SUBJECT} FACES THE CAMERAS
card.apology_tour.headline.2: THE {SUBJECT} SAYS SORRY. WILL ANYONE LISTEN?
card.collab_single.name: Collab Single
card.collab_single.text: Signed: gain 9 Hype and £2,000. Otherwise: gain 4 Hype, 2 Heat.
card.collab_single.flavor: Two names on the cover. One argument about the bridge.
card.collab_single.headline.1: A surprise collaboration lands at midnight. Worth staying up for?
card.collab_single.headline.2: Two voices, one song, and a bridge worth arguing about.
card.tabloid_bait.name: Tabloid Bait
card.tabloid_bait.text: 2+ Scandals: gain 10 Hype, 4 Heat. Otherwise: gain 3 Hype, 2 Heat.
card.tabloid_bait.flavor: Wear the hat. Walk past the café. Twice.
card.tabloid_bait.headline.1: AN "ANONYMOUS SOURCE" FILLS TODAY'S FRONT PAGE
card.tabloid_bait.headline.2: THE {SUBJECT} FEEDS THE PAPERS A STORY — AND THEY BITE
card.reinvent_image.name: Reinvent Your Image
card.reinvent_image.text: Remove a Stunt card for good. Lose 6 Heat and 2 Hype.
card.reinvent_image.flavor: New hair, new sound, same you. Probably.
card.reinvent_image.headline.1: NEW LOOK, NEW SOUND: THE BIG REINVENTION
card.reinvent_image.headline.2: THE {SUBJECT}'S BOLD NEW LOOK — AND IT'S DIVIDING FANS
card.sellout_ad.name: Sellout Ad
card.sellout_ad.flavor: It's thirty seconds. It's also forever.
card.sellout_ad.headline.1: You sing about yoghurt for thirty seconds. The money is extremely real.
card.sellout_ad.headline.2: A jingle for a building society. Four notes, a very large cheque.
card.street_team.name: Street Team
card.street_team.flavor: Your face on every lamppost by Friday.
card.street_team.headline.2: THE NAME ON EVERY LAMPPOST IN TOWN
card.demo_tape.name: Demo Tape
card.demo_tape.text: Needs 15 Craft. Add a Studio Session to your discard pile. Gain 2 Craft.
card.demo_tape.flavor: Three songs, one microphone, the neighbours' patience.
card.demo_tape.headline.1: You finish a demo worth sending. A studio says: come in next week.
card.demo_tape.headline.2: Four songs on a drive. Enough to get you back in the booth.
card.fan_meetup.name: Fan Meetup
card.fan_meetup.text: Went viral: gain 6 Hype and £2,000. Otherwise: gain 3 Hype and £1,000.
card.fan_meetup.headline.1: MEET-AND-GREET: FANS LINE UP FOR A PHOTO
card.fan_meetup.headline.2: SIGNED, SELFIED AND SENT HOME HAPPY
card.late_night_show.name: Late Night Show
card.late_night_show.text: Needs 25 Hype. Gain 8 Hype, 3 Heat. Craft 30+: lose 3 Heat.
card.late_night_show.flavor: Laugh at the joke. Plug the single. Don't trip on the step.
card.cover_single.name: Cover Single
card.cover_single.text: Gain £1,000 and 2 Heat. Craft 15+: gain 5 Hype. Otherwise: gain 3 Hype.
card.cover_single.flavor: Borrow the song. Make it owe you something.
card.cover_single.headline.1: Fans insist this cover beats the original. The jury's still out.
card.cover_single.headline.2: An old song, a new voice, and a lot of opinions.
card.brand_deal.name: Brand Deal
card.brand_deal.flavor: Smile. Hold the bottle a little higher.
card.brand_deal.headline.1: The contract's signed. Your face is on the side of a bus.
card.brand_deal.headline.2: Your face, a perfume, a very long contract.
card.film_cameo.name: Film Cameo
card.film_cameo.text: Opportunity. Needs 35 Hype. Gain 12 Hype, 2 Craft, 4 Heat.
card.film_cameo.flavor: Forty seconds on screen. Nine hours in the trailer.
card.film_cameo.headline.2: Brief Cameo, Big Talk: {Subject} Steals a Scene
card.mentorship.name: Mentorship
card.mentorship.flavor: Someone who has done this for thirty years says: slower.
card.mentorship.headline.1: An older singer takes you aside and tells you what no one else will.
card.mentorship.headline.2: Your mentor says one word after the take: again.
card.world_tour.name: World Tour
card.world_tour.text: Opportunity. Needs £5,000. Pay £5,000: gain 16 Hype, 6 Heat.
card.world_tour.headline.1: The tour is announced. The first nights sold out before lunch.
card.world_tour.headline.2: Twelve cities, one van, and a setlist nobody agrees on.
card.award_campaign.name: Award Campaign
card.award_campaign.text: Opportunity. Needs 40 Craft. Gain 7 Hype. Lose 2 Heat.
card.award_campaign.flavor: Shake every hand. Remember every name.
card.award_campaign.headline.1: Critics rally behind the year's most underrated voice.
card.award_campaign.headline.2: The campaign trail: handshakes, lunches and a very long list.
card.legal_team.name: Legal Team
card.legal_team.text: Opportunity. Needs a Scandal and £6,000. Pay £6,000: remove 2 Scandals for good.
card.legal_team.flavor: They bill by the minute. The minutes are worth it.
card.legal_team.headline.1: The lawyers send letters. Two stories quietly disappear.
card.legal_team.headline.2: A letter on heavy paper. A retraction on page nine.
card.indie_label.name: Indie Label
card.indie_label.text: Opportunity. Needs 40 Hype and £4,000, and no deal yet. Pay £4,000: you're signed.
card.indie_label.flavor: Small office, big plans, one spare chair.
card.indie_label.headline.1: A small label takes a chance on the {subject}.
card.indie_label.headline.2: Signed: a small label, a big handshake.
card.bad_press.name: The Review
card.bad_press.inhand.1: Someone quotes it at you. Again.
card.bad_press.inhand.2: The worst line of the review is now a meme.
card.burnout.name: Burnout
card.burnout.inhand.1: You're tired in a way sleep doesn't fix.
card.burnout.inhand.2: The diary is full. You are not.
card.burnout.headline.2: FRIENDS WORRY AS THE {SUBJECT} PULLS OUT OF SHOWS
card.copycat_story.name: Everyone's Running It
card.copycat_story.inhand.1: It keeps getting repeated. It keeps getting worse.
card.copycat_story.inhand.2: Someone new picks it up every morning.
card.copycat_story.headline.1: NOW EVERY OUTLET HAS THE STORY
card.copycat_story.headline.2: THE STORY THAT WON'T GO AWAY
card.old_rumor.name: Cash Grab
card.old_rumor.inhand.1: Every post about you has the same comment under it.
card.old_rumor.inhand.2: Every deal you take gets a comment about it.
card.old_rumor.headline.1: CASH GRAB? FANS TURN ON THE {SUBJECT}
card.old_rumor.headline.2: SOLD OUT? FANS QUESTION THE {SUBJECT}'S DEALS
card.screen_test.name: Screen Test
card.screen_test.text: Gain 4 Craft and 2 Hype. Craft 15+: gain 2 more Hype.
card.screen_test.flavor: Say your name. Now say it like you mean it.
card.screen_test.headline.1: A casting director watches you read three lines, then asks for them again.
card.screen_test.headline.2: You read for a part. Nobody tells you how it went.
card.acting_class.name: Acting Class
card.acting_class.text: Needs £1,000. Pay £1,000: gain 6 Craft, lose 1 Heat.
card.acting_class.flavor: Less. Do less. Let the camera find it.
card.acting_class.headline.1: Singing is one kind of honesty. This is another.
card.acting_class.headline.2: You learn to stand still and let the camera come to you.
card.guest_spot.name: Guest Spot
card.guest_spot.flavor: Hit your mark. Say the line. Don't look at the lens.
card.guest_spot.headline.2: Guest Spot Delivers a Season-High Episode
card.soundtrack_single.name: Soundtrack Single
card.soundtrack_single.text: Needs 20 Craft. Gain 5 Hype, 2 Craft, 2 Heat.
card.soundtrack_single.flavor: Your voice under someone else's ending.
card.soundtrack_single.headline.1: Soundtrack Cut Emerges as the Film's Breakout
card.soundtrack_single.headline.2: Soundtrack Single Climbs as the Film Opens
card.streaming_role.name: Streaming Role
card.streaming_role.text: Opportunity. Needs 25 Hype. Gain 9 Hype, 2 Craft, 3 Heat.
card.streaming_role.flavor: Episode four. Bring your own coat.
card.streaming_role.headline.1: {Subject} Inks Deal to Star in Streaming Drama
card.streaming_role.headline.2: Streaming Drama Adds {Subject} to Ensemble Cast
card.table_read.name: Table Read
card.table_read.flavor: Twelve chairs, one script, and nobody acting yet.
card.table_read.headline.1: You read the scene twice. The second time, you listen.
card.table_read.headline.2: A table read with strangers. By page ten, they're a cast.
card.self_tape.name: Self-Tape
card.self_tape.flavor: Take nine. The light was better in take two.
card.voice_over.name: Voice-Over
card.voice_over.flavor: Say it warmer. Now say it like a badger.
card.voice_over.headline.1: Voice-over work: three sessions, paid on time.
card.voice_over.headline.2: An advert needs a voice, not a face. It pays either way.
gate.audition.name: Open Audition
gate.audition.flavor.1: A real panel, a real audition. They don't care how many followers you have.
gate.showcase.name: Industry Showcase
gate.showcase.flavor.1: An industry showcase. Half the room came to be seen. You need to be seen more.
gate.festival.name: Festival Slot
gate.festival.flavor.1: A summer festival, second stage, mid-afternoon. Win over a crowd that came for someone else.
gate.session_work.name: Session Work
gate.session_work.flavor.1: Backing vocals on a major record. Pure craft. Nobody will ever know it was you.
gate.label_deal.name: Label Deal
gate.label_deal.flavor.1: A label wants a meeting. What they really want is proof you're a sure thing.
gate.residency.name: Club Residency
gate.residency.flavor.1: A weekly slot at a serious venue. They'll check your reputation before your setlist.
gate.arena_tour.name: Arena Tour
gate.arena_tour.flavor.1: A support slot on an arena tour — only for acts with a label behind them.
gate.award_show.name: Award Show
gate.award_show.flavor.1: A nomination, if the committee trusts you not to embarrass them on the night.
act.spring.name: Spring
act.spring.opener.1: Nobody knows your name yet. Enjoy it. It's the last time you'll have nothing to lose.
act.summer.name: Summer
act.summer.opener.1: Things are moving fast now. The choices you make this season have a way of following you.
act.autumn.name: Autumn
act.autumn.opener.1: The weather turns. So does the coverage. Whatever you did in summer, someone wrote it down.
act.winter.name: Winter
act.winter.opener.1: Awards season. The industry sits down to decide what you are. You'll carry everything you've done into that room.
ending.meltdown.name: Cautionary Tale
ending.meltdown.goal: Be everywhere, for all the wrong reasons.
ending.meltdown.text.1: By winter the story had stopped being about the music. It was about the feud, the photos, the apology, the apology for the apology. You were everywhere — that was the problem. Somewhere, a younger singer is being told about you as a warning, and the worst part is that most of what they're hearing is true. Still. You got what you wanted. Everyone knows your name.
ending.star.name: Headliner
ending.star.goal: Get famous, get signed, and keep your past from catching up with you.
ending.star.text.1: Your name is on the poster now, big enough to read from across the street. Strangers sing your chorus back at you — slightly wrong — and you let them. There were nights this year you'd rather not explain, and some of them are still out there, filed away somewhere, waiting. But tonight the room is full, and everyone in it came for you. Nobody gets to keep this. You get to have it.
ending.the_one_to_watch.name: The One to Watch
ending.the_one_to_watch.text.1: You're not famous. Not yet. But your name keeps turning up on the lists — the ones to watch, the ones about to break — and people you've never met already have opinions about you. You spent the year being seen everywhere that matters. Next year you find out whether being seen is the same thing as being known.
ending.craftsman.name: The Musician's Musician
ending.craftsman.goal: Be genuinely great, and known just enough to be taken seriously.
ending.craftsman.text.1: You won't be recognised in the supermarket. You'll be recognised in studios, by people who know exactly how hard the thing you just did was. Session players ask how you phrased that bridge. A producer you've admired for years sends a message that says only: again? It isn't fame, and some nights you wonder if it's enough. But it's the kind of reputation that outlasts fame.
ending.nobody.name: Nobody Yet
ending.nobody.goal: What happens if the year gets away from you.
ending.nobody.text.1: The year ends quietly. No headlines, good or bad. You're still singing, mostly to rooms that aren't paying attention, and some mornings that feels like failure and some mornings it feels like the most honest thing you've done. Most people who come to this city don't last a year. You did. There's no rule that says it has to happen now.
ending.breakthrough.name: The Breakthrough
ending.breakthrough.goal: Get famous, and keep your name clean.
ending.long_game.name: The Long Game
ending.long_game.goal: Build slowly, stay clean, and wait for your moment.
ending.overexposed.name: Overexposed
ending.overexposed.goal: Get famous, and let it cost you.
ending.hard_way.name: The Hard Way
ending.hard_way.goal: Take the shortcuts and find out where they lead.
ending.the_independent.name: The Independent
ending.the_independent.text.1: You did it without them. No label, no machine, no one telling you which songs to cut. The numbers are yours and so is every decision behind them, including the ones that kept you up at night. It's lonelier than the other way. The industry still isn't sure what to call you. You've stopped needing them to.
ending.leading_role.name: Leading Role
ending.leading_role.text.1: It started as a cameo. Now your name is above the title. People who never heard you sing know your face from the screen, and some of them are surprised to learn you ever did anything else. You still hum between takes. The camera turned out to be another kind of audience — one that remembers everything, and forgives more than you expected.
ending.household_name.name: Household Name
ending.household_name.text.1: You're not just a singer anymore. You're a face on a billboard, a guest on every show, a name people use as shorthand. Strangers feel like they know you. In a way, they do — you've given them so much of yourself that there's a version of you everywhere. The hard part now is remembering which one is real.
ending.redemption_arc.name: The Redemption Arc
ending.redemption_arc.text.1: For a while there, it looked like the story was going to be the scandal. It nearly was. But you stopped running, answered for what you could, and did the work in public where everyone could watch you fail again. They didn't get the ending they were writing. Comebacks are the only story the papers love more than a fall.
ending.tabloid_royalty.name: Tabloid Royalty
ending.tabloid_royalty.text.1: Somewhere along the way you stopped fighting the headlines and started writing them. Every feud is a trending topic, every rumour a week of free publicity. You're the name editors reach for on a slow day. It works, in its way. It just means you can never go quiet again — because the moment you do, they'll find someone else to be you.
ending.character_actor.name: The Character Actor
ending.character_actor.text.1: You're not the star. You're the one directors call when the scene has to work. Casting sheets say "the singer from that thing" and then, a few years later, just your name. It isn't fame. It's steadier than fame — the kind of career where you're always working, and nobody ever asks you to be anyone but good.
ending.flash_in_the_pan.name: Flash in the Pan
ending.flash_in_the_pan.text.1: For one month, everyone knew your name. You remember the exact week it peaked — the week you checked your phone forty times a day. Then it moved on, the way it always does, and took the attention with it. You're left with the memory, a few good stories, and the strange knowledge of exactly how fast it can all go.
ending.running_on_empty.name: Running on Empty
ending.running_on_empty.text.1: You gave it everything and it took everything. The shows got harder to finish, the songs harder to find, and somewhere in the autumn you stopped remembering why you started. You're tired in a way sleep doesn't fix. This isn't the end. But the next thing you do has to be rest, or there won't be a next thing.
ending.starting_over.name: Starting Over
ending.starting_over.text.1: It didn't go the way you planned. You took the chances that looked like shortcuts and found out most of them weren't. But you're still here, which is more than most. You know things now that you didn't in the spring — about the business, about the press, about yourself. That's not nothing. Next year, you'll know where the traps are.
story.opening.1:
Spring.

You have a demo recorded in a friend's bedroom, a coat that isn't quite warm enough, and a phone that doesn't ring.

Everyone in this city wants to be seen. That's the easy part. The trouble is, once people start looking, they don't stop.

You have one year.
award.best_new_artist.name: Best New Artist
award.best_new_artist.citation: For a debut year that made the rest of the industry feel slow.
award.breakthrough_of_the_year.name: Breakthrough of the Year
award.breakthrough_of_the_year.citation: From nowhere to everywhere in twelve months.
award.peoples_choice.name: People's Choice
award.peoples_choice.citation: Voted for by the fans. All of them, apparently.
award.critics_choice.name: Critics' Choice
award.critics_choice.citation: The year's most overlooked voice. You may not have heard them. You should have.
award.comeback_of_the_year.name: Comeback of the Year
award.comeback_of_the_year.citation: For proving the second act can outshine the first — and that the first can be survived.
award.scandal_of_the_year.name: Scandal of the Year
award.scandal_of_the_year.citation: For services to the gossip pages. We couldn't have filled them without you.
award.most_promising_newcomer.name: Most Promising Newcomer (Still)
flag.signed_label.negative: Not yet signed to a label
tip.hype.2: A few people have started to recognise you. Mostly bar staff.
tip.hype.3: People are starting to say your name.
tip.hype.4: Strangers know your name. Some of them have opinions.
tip.hype.5: Everyone knows who you are. There's no going back.
tip.craft.singing.1: You can hold a tune. Just about.
tip.craft.singing.3: You can carry a song on your own.
tip.craft.singing.4: Other musicians have started to listen.
tip.craft.singing.5: You make the hard parts sound easy.
tip.craft.singing.6: People will be learning your songs for years.
tip.craft.acting.1: You know which way to face the camera.
tip.craft.acting.2: You're learning to do less, and let the camera come to you.
tip.craft.acting.4: Directors have stopped giving you notes.
tip.heat.2: A few people are asking questions.
tip.heat.3: People are talking about you, and not always kindly.
tip.heat.4: They're one slip away from a story.
tip.heat.5: A story will print at the end of the month.
tip.heat.6: It's everywhere. It will get worse before it gets better.
tip.money: Money won't make you famous. It pays for what does — and for whoever cleans up after.
tip.next.togo: How much more heat you can take before a scandal prints at the end of the month.
tip.next.tonext: A scandal is already coming this month. This is how close you are to a second.
tip.actions: What you can still do this month. Each card you play uses one.
date.left.none: The last month of the year.

script.low.1.heading: INT. HOSPITAL – NIGHT
script.low.1.line.1: NURSE: Doctor, your evil twin is here.
script.low.1.line.2: YOU: I don't have a twin!
script.low.2.heading: EXT. CAR PARK – NIGHT
script.low.3.heading: INT. KITCHEN – DAY
script.low.3.line.1: YOU: (beaming) It's like a hug for your mouth!
script.mid.1.heading: INT. INTERVIEW ROOM – NIGHT
script.mid.1.line.1: DETECTIVE: You were at the docks.
script.mid.1.line.2: YOU: I was nowhere near the docks.
script.mid.2.heading: INT. KITCHEN – DAY
script.mid.2.line.1: YOU: I didn't come back for the house, Dad. I came back because you asked.
script.mid.3.heading: EXT. HOSPITAL ROOF – NIGHT
script.high.1.heading: EXT. PLATFORM – NIGHT – RAIN
script.high.1.line.2: YOU: If I get on, I won't come back. We both know it.
script.high.2.heading: INT. EMPTY THEATRE – NIGHT
script.high.2.line.2: YOU: Every night I tell them who I am. Tonight, you tell me.
script.high.3.heading: INT. DRESSING ROOM – NIGHT
script.high.3.line.1: (You study the mirror a long time.)
script.high.3.line.2: YOU: (quietly) So that's what they see.
manager.choice.title: You need someone in your corner.
manager.choice.subtitle: They'll be with you all year.
manager.veteran.name: Dex Holloway
manager.veteran.quote: "Nobody pays to see talent. They pay to see a story."
manager.veteran.description: Twenty years in. Knows everyone. Expects results.
manager.veteran.perk.name: Knows everyone
manager.veteran.perk.effect.d1: Every draft offers you one more card.
manager.veteran.perk.effect.d2: Every draft offers you one more card, and your first reroll each season is free.
manager.veteran.sample.label: How he texts
manager.veteran.sample.text: Good week. Now let's make it louder.
manager.guardian.name: Marguerite Ashby
manager.guardian.quote: "You don't owe them anything. Remember why you started."
manager.guardian.description: Knew you before any of this. Will know you after.
manager.guardian.perk.name: Calms things down
manager.guardian.perk.effect.m1: You lose 1 heat at the end of every season.
manager.guardian.perk.effect.m2: You lose 2 heat at the end of every season.
manager.guardian.perk.effect.m3: You lose 1 heat at the end of every other month.
manager.guardian.sample.label: How she texts
manager.guardian.sample.text: Are you eating? Call me when you can.
manager.veteran.perk.reroll: Reroll the offer (free — Dex knows someone)
manager.guardian.perk.relief.2: Mags talks someone out of a story.
manager.guardian.perk.relief.3: Mags has a quiet word with an editor.
manager.veteran.opening.1: Right. You've got a demo and a pulse. That's more than most.
manager.veteran.opening.1.b: Get me something I can sell.
manager.veteran.opening.2: First rule: nobody cares yet. Use that.
manager.veteran.opening.2.b: Make some noise before they start watching.
manager.guardian.opening.1: Well. We're really doing this, then.
manager.guardian.opening.1.b: Sing, eat something, sleep. In that order.
manager.guardian.opening.2: I'm proud of you for starting, love.
manager.veteran.checkin.breakthrough.1: The numbers are good. Don't get comfortable.
manager.veteran.checkin.breakthrough.2: You're famous and you're clean. Rarer than you'd think. Keep it that way.
manager.guardian.checkin.breakthrough.1: Look at you. Famous and still yourself.
manager.guardian.checkin.breakthrough.2: People know your name now, love. Mind what you do with it.
manager.veteran.checkin.long_game.1: You're good. You're also invisible. Pick one to fix.
manager.veteran.checkin.long_game.2: Talent's not the problem. Nobody knowing about it is.
manager.veteran.checkin.long_game.3: Good work nobody's seen is still good work. It's just not a career yet.
manager.veteran.checkin.long_game.4: You're building something. Build it faster.
manager.guardian.checkin.long_game.2: You're better every month. That part's yours to keep.
manager.guardian.checkin.long_game.3: Nobody's in a hurry but the papers, love.
manager.guardian.checkin.long_game.4: You're getting good at the part that lasts.
manager.veteran.checkin.overexposed.1: Everyone knows you. That's not the same as everyone liking you.
manager.veteran.checkin.overexposed.2: You're famous and you're a mess. I can sell one of those.
manager.guardian.checkin.overexposed.1: I don't care what they're printing. I care how you're sleeping.
manager.guardian.checkin.overexposed.2: It's a lot, isn't it? You're allowed to put some of it down.
manager.veteran.checkin.hard_way.1: All the trouble of being famous, none of the money. Let's fix that.
manager.veteran.checkin.hard_way.2: You took the shortcuts. They didn't go anywhere.
manager.guardian.checkin.hard_way.1: It's been a hard year. It isn't over yet.
manager.guardian.checkin.hard_way.2: You don't have to prove anything to anyone, love. Just start again.
manager.veteran.first_scandal.low.1: It's a small story. Small stories are cheap to kill.
manager.veteran.first_scandal.low.2: Nobody's reading about you yet. Clean it up before they start.
manager.guardian.first_scandal.low.1: It's only a little thing. Let's put it right while it's little.
manager.guardian.first_scandal.low.2: Hardly anyone saw it, love. Fix it now and it's gone.
manager.veteran.first_scandal.high.1: Front page. You're officially worth gossiping about.
manager.veteran.first_scandal.high.1.b: Don't give them a second one.
manager.veteran.first_scandal.high.2: Stories are currency. This one's costing you.
manager.guardian.first_scandal.high.1: I saw it. Are you all right? That's all I want to know.
manager.guardian.first_scandal.high.2: Don't read it. I mean it. Ring me instead.
manager.veteran.frenzy.low.1: Two stories in one month, and you're not even famous. That's a gift.
manager.veteran.frenzy.low.2: Nobody's watching yet. Use that. Disappear for a bit.
manager.guardian.frenzy.low.1: It's piling up, love. Take a breath. Do something quiet.
manager.guardian.frenzy.low.2: It's small, but it's a lot of small. Let's slow down.
manager.veteran.frenzy.high.1: Don't read the comments. Don't post. Don't do anything until I call.
manager.veteran.frenzy.high.2: It's everywhere. The good news: so is your name. The bad news: everything else.
manager.guardian.frenzy.high.1: This isn't going away on its own. Go quiet for a while. Please.
manager.guardian.frenzy.high.2: Turn your phone off. I'll deal with them. You look after you.
manager.veteran.stuck.1: You keep crossing the line and acting surprised. Go quiet.
manager.veteran.stuck.2: Every month you run this hot, it costs you. Cool it down.
manager.guardian.stuck.1: It isn't going to stop by itself, love. Something has to change.
manager.guardian.stuck.2: You've been on edge for months. Let it settle.
manager.veteran.signed.1: Signed. Now the real work: making them glad they did.
manager.veteran.signed.2: You've got a label. They've got expectations. Guess which lasts longer.
manager.guardian.signed.1: A proper contract! I nearly cried in the shop.
manager.guardian.signed.1.b: Read every page of the next one.
manager.guardian.signed.2: They've taken a chance on you. You earned that.
manager.veteran.known.1: You're not a nobody any more. That was the easy part.
manager.veteran.known.2: People recognise you now. Everything counts from here.
manager.guardian.known.1: Someone asked for your autograph in front of me. I had to sit down.
manager.guardian.known.2: You're known now, love. Be kind to the people who knew you first.
manager.veteran.lane.music.1: You're a musician first. Fine. Musicians last longer.
manager.veteran.lane.music.2: The songs are doing the work. Keep feeding them.
manager.guardian.lane.music.1: It's the music they're talking about. That's the best kind.
manager.guardian.lane.music.2: Keep singing. That's the part nobody can take off you.
manager.veteran.lane.screen.1: Film people keep calling. Can you act? Doesn't matter. Say yes.
manager.veteran.lane.screen.2: Screen money beats record money. Just saying.
manager.guardian.lane.screen.1: A casting director called. Twice. Should I be worried?
manager.guardian.lane.screen.2: Acting, now? You were always the one doing the voices.
manager.veteran.lane.celebrity.1: Your face is worth more than your voice right now. Let's use both.
manager.veteran.lane.celebrity.2: You're a brand now. Brands need looking after.
manager.guardian.lane.celebrity.1: Your face is everywhere this week. Just — pace yourself.
manager.guardian.lane.celebrity.2: I liked it better when they talked about your singing, love.
manager.veteran.gate_passed.1: You got through. Don't celebrate. The next door's heavier.
manager.veteran.gate_passed.2: Good. That's a door open. Walk through it.
manager.guardian.gate_passed.1: You did it! I knew you would. I didn't sleep, but I knew.
manager.guardian.gate_passed.2: Look what you just did. Remember this one.
manager.veteran.gate_failed.2: One door shut. There's always another. Usually dearer.
manager.guardian.gate_failed.1: It wasn't your night. That's all it was.
manager.guardian.gate_failed.2: Come here. It's one door, love. There'll be others.
manager.veteran.viral.1: Half the country watched you in the last hour. Let's get the other half.
manager.veteran.viral.2: Viral. Lovely. Now make it mean something before it fades.
manager.guardian.viral.1: My neighbour showed me the clip. My neighbour!
manager.guardian.viral.2: Everyone's seen it. Are you all right with that?
manager.veteran.rival.1: Juno Vale's everywhere this month. Good. Now you know the bar.
manager.veteran.rival.2: Don't watch Juno Vale. Beat her.
manager.veteran.rival.3: Juno Vale's in the papers again. Your turn.
manager.veteran.quiet.low.1: Quiet month. Enjoy it — nobody's watching yet, so nobody's keeping score.
manager.veteran.quiet.low.2: I sent your demo to three people. One of them listened.
manager.veteran.quiet.low.3: Nothing to report. That's not the same as nothing happening.
manager.veteran.quiet.mid.1: People are starting to ask about you. Don't get precious about it.
manager.veteran.quiet.mid.2: A promoter asked for your number. I gave him mine.
manager.veteran.quiet.mid.3: Your name came up at lunch. Not my lunch. Somebody's.
manager.veteran.quiet.high.1: Three offers this morning. Two are rubbish. I'll tell you which.
manager.veteran.quiet.high.2: You're famous now. Everything you don't do is news too.
manager.veteran.quiet.high.3: Take the week. You've earned one. Just the one.
manager.veteran.last.breakthrough: Told you. A story people want to be in.
manager.veteran.last.long_game: Nobody knows yet. That's the only part I can fix.
manager.veteran.last.overexposed: Everyone knows your name. We'll decide later if that's good.
manager.veteran.last.hard_way: Bad year. I've had worse ones.
manager.guardian.rival.1: I saw Juno Vale in the paper. You're doing it your way. That matters.
manager.guardian.rival.2: Don't measure yourself against Juno Vale, love. Different road.
manager.guardian.rival.3: Juno Vale's doing her thing. You keep doing yours.
manager.guardian.quiet.low.1: Nobody's writing about you yet. That's fine — it means you can still choose what they'll write.
manager.guardian.quiet.low.2: Quiet month, love. Quiet months are where the good work happens.
manager.guardian.quiet.low.3: I walked past the open mic on Thursday. They were still talking about your set.
manager.guardian.quiet.mid.1: You made the paper this week. Page four, but still — I bought three copies.
manager.guardian.quiet.mid.2: People have started saying your name in rooms I'm in. It's a strange feeling.
manager.guardian.quiet.mid.3: A booker rang to ask if you're free next month. I said you'd think about it.
manager.guardian.quiet.high.1: You're on every front page. Enjoy it, and be careful — they write faster than you can sing.
manager.guardian.quiet.high.2: Someone stopped me in the shop to ask if I really know you. I said I'd never met you.
manager.guardian.quiet.high.3: Three offers came in this morning. I haven't said yes to any of them.
manager.guardian.last.breakthrough: You did it, and you're still you. That's the bit I'm proud of.
manager.guardian.last.long_game: Nobody's written the story yet. It's still yours.
manager.guardian.last.overexposed: They'll forget the headlines. I won't forget that you got through it.
manager.guardian.last.hard_way: It was a hard year. You're still standing in it.
